howto: Your runner dashes down a three-lane neon road that keeps speeding up.
Change lanes around orange walls, jump red barriers and pink drones, slide under yellow beams.
Grab coins to build a combo (up to x8) and glowing diamonds for power-ups. One crash ends the run.
tips: Coins in a row build your combo; five seconds without one resets it to x1.
A SHIELD soaks up exactly one hit, so it is safe to take a risky line while it glows.
BOOST makes you untouchable for 3 seconds: ride it straight through the traffic.
Pink drones sweep sideways across the lanes: jump them or pick another lane.

controls.keyboard: ← → or A / D change lanes, ↑, W or Space jumps, ↓ or S slides. P or Esc pauses; Space or Enter restarts after a crash.
controls.touch: Swipe left or right to change lanes, up to jump, down to slide. Tap START to run; the pause button is top right.

difficulty: EASY, NORMAL or HARD on the title sets the start speed, the top speed and how fast the pace climbs (EASY 5 to 20, NORMAL 6 to 28, HARD 8 to 34). Each keeps its own best and top-5 table. The LVL counter ticks up every 20 seconds while the pace keeps rising.

settings.quality: Title screen > GFX: HIGH / LOW (HIGH renders at up to 2x resolution; LOW at 1x with half the particles)

features.difficulty: EASY / NORMAL / HARD pills on the title: start speed, top speed and ramp; separate bests and tables
features.power-up-list: Power-up legend on the title (green MAGNET pulls coins, cyan SHIELD blocks a hit, orange BOOST dash and untouchable), plus live timers at the bottom while one is active
features.wave-or-level-counter: LVL in the HUD goes up every 20 seconds of running, with a LEVEL flash
features.high-score-table: TOP RUNS on the crash screen: the 5 best runs for the chosen difficulty, with dates, this run highlighted
features.results: CRASHED screen with score, coins, distance, NEW BEST and the top-5 table; RESTART or Space
features.tutorial: First run: three coach steps (change lanes, jump, slide) each wait for you to do it; crashes don't count for the first 20 seconds while you learn. Skippable, and replayed from How to play
